summary: On-demand UI generation is defensible when it produces a constrained declarative artifact with deterministic identity, validation, and stable user interaction semantics.

points.text: The cache key should include artifact content, schema version, generator and prompt version, component registry, locale, theme, and security policy; otherwise stale UI can survive a meaningful input change.
Generate a typed component tree or schema, not executable HTML and JavaScript. The host should own rendering, event wiring, navigation, and side-effect authorization.
Acceptance must include schema validation, sanitization, accessibility checks, interaction tests, and unsupported-state handling. A visually plausible render is not sufficient.
Regeneration needs stable semantic keys and state migration so focus, entered data, user preferences, and learned locations do not disappear with every artifact revision.
